QUOTE: Patterns are `tool` or `tool:argpattern`, matched with `fnmatch` (`permission_manager.cpp:101`): - The text before the first `:` is matched against the fully-qualified tool name. - With no `:`, the tool match is enough. - With a `:`, the text after it is matched against `tool:<arg value>`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, a split at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone.
